Own exactly packages/moe-daemon/src/state/checkObservationStore.ts, checkObservationStore.test.ts and docs/MCP_SERVER.md. Replace validateDispatch command cap500 with imported MAX_REQUIRED_CHECK_COMMAND_CHARS=1000. implementationPlan.description: Use test-driven-development with the existing dispatch/observe/refused/snapshot/restart helpers. Accept 500,501,1000 UTF-16-unit commands through real recordCheckDispatch -> recordCheckObservation -> stored CheckRun and assert exact command, candidate/tree/revision/channel-runner binding and isAuthenticatedCheckRun=true. Include leading/trailing whitespace in the 1000-unit accepted command and 500 supplementary-plane emoji; reject 1001 ASCII units and 500 emoji plus one ASCII unit before writeEntity/files/maps. Replace the obsolete501-refusal row with1001 and assert field=command and the1000-limit error. Import MAX_REQUIRED_CHECK_COMMAND_CHARS from ./validators.js and pass it to requireText for command only; preserve all other validation and error handling. Test1000-unit identical dispatch/observation replay without writes, changed-command immutable refusal, and exact command/authentication after fresh StateManager reload. Keep current wrong-runner, stale-revision/current-candidate, marker-missing/tampering and write-failure tests unchanged; do not alter production binding or persistence order.

Update docs/MCP_SERVER.md record_check_run command parameter, its over-limit refusal prose and record_check_dispatch command parameter from500 to1000 UTF-16 code units, preserving nonblank/verbatim and authentication caveats. No unrelated255/500/10000 limits change. SCHEMA was assigned entirely to prerequisitead5 by the task comment; parent4e8a owns the public tool schemas and cross-language integration, not this document.

VERIFY: full daemon regression for this shared authenticated-recording contract. Create a full git archive snapshot outside the live checkout, overlay ONLY the final three owned files and export its absolute path as MOE_VERIFY_SNAPSHOT; install host-native daemon dependencies there with npm ci and no lockfile changes. WSL uses Linux-only Node/npm/Git PATH, not Windows node_modules. Run exactly cd "$MOE_VERIFY_SNAPSHOT/packages/moe-daemon" && npm test. Record source SHA, overlay, exitCode and fresh outputTail as completion evidence. Never run live checkout daemon npm tests/installs/builds, edit .moe or pattern-kill processes. Preserve foreign dirty bytes; gate failure requires correction/reporting rather than suppressing tests.

Final adversarial self-review on this slice: ensure bound is imported rather than redefined; UTF-16 and whitespace behavior agree with CheckRun and approvals; every invalid dispatch writes nothing; replay still precedes currency checks; runner identity cannot come from args; marker creation/write-failure semantics and case-collision protection remain. Probe changed command/same id and long forged diagnostic runs against authentication. No trusted-evidence or verified-local enablement. If corrections alter final bytes, rerun the same gate on the refreshed snapshot.
